text:
alex: quick flag  ran the clustering+recall battery for emberglow-v2-int6 (per-channel 6-bit) on en/it/zh holdouts. recall@5 down ~3.5pts and a few clusters blew up in within-cluster variance. anyone seen something similar? :wave:

mina: can you drop the run stub + quant/calib details?

alex: pasted short config/results: 

```
model: emberglow-v2-int6
holdouts: en/it/zh (8k each)
calib: 1200 pooled random
quant: per-channel symmetric 6-bit
postproc: centering + optional whitening
metrics (float -> quant):
  recall@1: 0.72 -> 0.70
  recall@5: 0.89 -> 0.855
  silhouette: 0.26 -> 0.16
  idflip_rate: 0.3% -> 2.7%
```

cordelia: idflip x9-ish is a red flag. did preprocessing change (whitening params?) or batch-size?

alex: preprocessing identical. toggling whitening off improved recall@5 by ~0.6pts but silhouette still poor.

rene: likely calibration sampling bias. with pooled random calib rare-token dims can get wrong scales and then quant steps warp tail clusters. can you compute per-dim activation counts and centroid L2 deltas per cluster?

alex: did that quickly: 
```
centroid_l2_median: 0.11
centroid_l2_95p: 0.33
clusters with delta>0.5: [12(zh-tail), 47(it-tail)]
dims flagged by activation heur: [17, 89, 211]
```

mina: that matches my toy repro last week. dims with low activation count in calib but spikes in holdouts cause scale swings. what's the calib sample composition?

alex: pooled random 1200 across langs, not stratified by token freq or language.

rene: try these two quick experiments: (A) stratified calibration by token-frequency deciles (ensure tail sampling) (B) per-language calibration (separate scale per lang) and (C) a cosine/unit-norm evaluation to isolate magnitude shifts.

alex: queued stratified n=2400 and per-lang calib n=1200 each. also queued L2-normalize eval.

eval-bot: run 1777771234 submitted. results (per-cluster recall, centroid deltas, per-dim scale diffs, nn histograms) will be at https://eval.internal/reports/1777771234 once ready.

mina: also collect k=200 neighbor-distance distributions (intra vs inter) and per-cluster kurtosis pre/post quant. helps confirm whether intra-cluster spread increased or inter-cluster gap decreased.

alex: micro-stratified run (small holdout) results: recall@5 +1.4 pts, silhouette +0.06 median, idflip -> 1.1%. centroid median delta -> 0.06. still two clusters with >0.45 delta.

cordelia: good sign. can you upload per-dim scale ratios (pooled->stratified) and list dims with ratio outside [0.5,2.0]? those probably map to the remaining problem clusters.

alex: excerpt from report: dims out-of-range: [17 (ratio 3.2), 211 (ratio 0.28), 89 (ratio 2.6)]. sample notes: dim17 had almost no activations in pooled calib but frequent in zh tail.

rene: for remaining outliers we can try selective asymmetric quant on dims where activation_count < threshold OR skew>3. asymmetric reduces clipping on one side and can help rare-token signals. run selective-asym for flagged dims only.

mina: also propose adding a synthetic longtail generator to the eval harness: build queries weighted to 5th-10th freq percentile tokens and assert recall@5 drop < 1.5pts. will catch regressions early.

alex: ran selective-asym micro-run for flagged dims: outliers mostly recovered (cluster deltas <0.2) and recall@5 within 0.8pts of float. idflip ~0.6%.

cordelia: that's promising. if stratified+selective-asym together fix the regressions we should change quant pipeline default: stratified-by-frequency sampling for embedding calibrations and enable selective-asym for low-activation dims behind a flag. include synthetic longtail CI.

rene: small caution: per-language calib can bloat metadata (we store scales per lang). prefer stratified global calib first; only if language-specific residuals persist do per-lang scales.

mina: agreed. also add an integration test that runs the embedding index (HNSW+PQ) using the quantized vectors to ensure search-level metrics match. sometimes index config sensitivities appear only under load.

alex: plan: 1) finish full stratified run on full holdouts + k=200 nn histograms 2) run full selective-asym on flagged dims 3) if green, open PR to set stratified-by-freq default for embedding calib and add synthetic longtail CI + integration index test 4) hold per-lang calib as a fallback with product opt-in. will post PR/link here. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: interim results posted: https://eval.internal/reports/1777771234/summary (contains per-cluster charts + per-dim scale tables) :white_check_mark:

cordelia: great write-up. ping me to review the PR and the synthetic generator parameters.

alex: thanks all, will update when full runs finish (~50m). :coffee:
